parameters.help_en:
The list of check annotations.


For some third-party systems, code quality detection results may be obtained. To display the results, you can call the API to write the information to the check run as annotations
parameters.help_zh:
检查注释列表


对于某些三方系统，可能会获得代码质量检测结果，若希望进行展示，可通过API将信息通过annotation写入到check run中
parameters.name: annotations

parameters.help_en:
The completion time of the check run.


Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ format. Example: 2023-03-15T08:00:00Z
parameters.help_zh:
检查运行的完结时间


说明 ISO 8601 格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ，如 2023-03-15T08:00:00Z
parameters.name: completed_at

parameters.help_en:
The conclusion.

Valid values:
cancelled: The check run is canceled.
failure: The check run failed.
neutral: The check run is in a neutral state, which is considered a success.
success: The check run succeeded.
skipped: The check run is skipped, which is considered a success.
timed_out: The check run timed out
parameters.help_zh:
结论

cancelled：已取消
failure：失败
neutral：中立状态，算作成功状态
success：成功
skipped：跳过，算作成功状态
timed_out：超时
parameters.name: conclusion

parameters.help_en: The URL of the third-party interactive system details page. You can specify the URL, and the platform only provides the redirection capability
parameters.help_zh: 三方交互系统的详情地址，由用户自行决定，平台仅提供跳转能力
parameters.name: details_url

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the external system.
The external system refers to your detection system. You can determine the ID to be written to this field. The platform stores the ID as a string
parameters.help_zh:
外部系统的ID
外部系统，指用户的检测系统；该字段由用户自行决定写入何种ID，平台仅使用字符串类型进行存储
parameters.name: external_id

parameters.help_en:
The commit ID.


The commit SHA. Make sure that the commit is the source of a merge request
parameters.help_zh:
提交ID


Commit SHA，但需要确保该commit是某个合并请求的合并源
parameters.name: head_sha

parameters.help_en:
The name of the check run.


The name must be unique within a specific context, such as a specified code repository, commit ID, and author. The name can be up to 50 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
检查运行的名称


在一定环境下（指定代码库、提交ID、写入人），名称具有唯一性；长度限制在50以内
parameters.name: name
